Cover keyboard and drag controls against persisted order, with the reconnecting head preserved and no resend. * refactor(ui): reuse the movable queue segment during reorder Check only the crossed rows for edit conflicts and split the already identified movable segment. Preserve reorder behavior while keeping the startup bundle within its existing budget.

items.title: fix(ui): stop unrelated sidebar child refreshes (#146410)
items.summary: fix(ui): stop unrelated sidebar child refreshes (#146410) * fix(ui): stop unrelated sidebar child refreshes Keep child windows under their managed query owner and target history invalidation to affected membership without refreshing the supplying query. Preserve descriptor freshness, complete pagination, retry errors, ancestry, and connection/disposal lifecycles while avoiding repeated sidebar reads. Related: #146122 * fix(ui): preserve child query recovery and share refresh work Keep failed sidebar child observations dormant until explicit retry, including synchronous errors from queries retained by another view. Preserve incomplete pagination errors and retire their leases without reopening background reads. Align the mounted-sidebar regressions with managed child-event refresh and make scheduled event assertions deterministic. Share stale-row comparison, result projection, event parsing, and refresh lifecycle operations to keep the startup bundle within its existing budget. Validation: 1,598 session/sidebar/bootstrap tests, 10 Chromium scenarios, UI production and test types, UI lint, import-cycle checks, and controlled startup bundle check. Fresh review found no actionable P0-P2 findings. * perf(ui): load website hints with dashboard widgets Keep the shared Website label eager and register the three website-only hints synchronously with the widget. Compose the same canonical English catalog without mutating the runtime catalog; all 9,018 keys retain their text and order. Forward public session invalidation directly to its existing closure-owned scheduler without a redundant wrapper. The public zero-argument contract stays unchanged. Validation: 1,752 tests across 80 files, 12 Chromium scenarios, unchanged catalog bytes and key order, i18n verification, production/test types, lint, import-cycle checks, and the unchanged startup gzip gate. Fresh review found no actionable P0-P2 findings. * refactor(ui): share session result projections Use the existing result-identity owner for terminal updates, pending mutations, permission projection, confirmed archives, and Swarm presentation. Preserve mapper order, side effects, membership and metadata while removing repeated change tracking and result copies. Record model-catalog notice state, text and group in one E2E DOM snapshot while retaining the same empty-notice assertion and timing. The prior single CI failure remains unexplained; exact-source local checks pass and no race fix is claimed. Validation: 1,752 tests, 12 mocked Chromium scenarios, exact-source Node 24 real-Gateway diagnostic proof, UI types/lint, import-cycle checks, and unchanged startup bundle gate at 355052 bytes gzip. Fresh review has no actionable P0-P2 findings.
